title: podman kube play: create service containers for Jobs and DaemonSets
body:
Playing a Job or DaemonSet with --wait or in a Quadlet unit leaves serviceContainer nil. The workload can start, but the subsequent sdnotify handling panics when inspecting or waiting for the service container.

Create the service container for these kinds as well, and check that it is removed with the pod.

Found by Linux Verification Center (linuxtesting.org) with SVACE.
